page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highcpu-48 is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the c4d server family. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 CPU architecture. The instance is configured with 90.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of approximately 1.88 GB per vCPU.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. There are no integrated GPUs on this instance, and it does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The c4d-highcpu-48 is designed for compute-bound workloads where processing power is prioritized over large memory footprints or local storage. Its dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance for multi-threaded applications, batch processing, high-performance web serving, and compute-heavy CI/CD pipelines. The low memory-per-core ratio makes it a cost-efficient choice for raw CPU scaling, though it is less suitable for memory-intensive databases or large-scale data caching.
